title: [Master]-Opening price list from Customer Card is extremely slow on large datasets (~220s) due to AddAllSourceType call
summary: Price list opening from a customer card is optimized to avoid a slow AddAllSourceType call that caused significant delays on datasets with many price lists.
key_points: Removed inefficient AddAllSourceType call that was causing performance bottleneck
Price list page now opens much faster on large datasets
Optimization reduces opening time from approximately 220 seconds to acceptable level
Changes apply to the Price List Management codeunit
Test cases added to ensure optimization works correctly
